ValidationRule.description: Regulated projects need a Region Key resolving through VLOOKUP into an active Rate Table row with a capped rate, a location within 3000 miles of a reference point, an 18-char CASESAFEID account, a positive currency rate and a line-break-free name.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Regulated'), OR( ISBLANK(Region_Key__c), IF( LEN(TRIM(Region_Key__c)) <> 3, TRUE, OR( ISBLANK(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Rate_Table__c.Fields.Region__c, $ObjectType.Rate_Table__c.Fields.Name, UPPER(Region_Key__c))), NULLVALUE(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Rate_Table__c.Fields.Rate__c, $ObjectType.Rate_Table__c.Fields.Name, UPPER(Region_Key__c)), 1) > 0.25 ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Location__latitude__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(Location__longitude__s)), DISTANCE(Location__c, GEOLOCATION(37.7749, -122.4194), 'mi') > 3000 ), CURRENCYRATE('USD') <= 0, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Account__c)), LEN(CASESAFEID(Account__c)) <> 18), CONTAINS(Name, BR()) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Regulated project failed the region, geo, currency or identity gate.
